title: Unit Event — Friendship Rebuilt — Episode2 A New Approach

meta.Event Outline: In the wake of iHaz, MORE MORE JUMP! are inundated with work offers. After taking a fresh look at their schedule, Airi and the rest of MMJ consider adopting a work style that makes use of the credit-based course.

rows.Line: The next day
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've tried adjusting our schedule a few different ways, but it just doesn't seem like we'll be able to accept more offers...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As much as I don't want to, we're gonna have to turn a few of these people down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? A new email...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, it's from that radio program.
I asked them yesterday to see if they can change the meeting date, but let's see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not really possible, huh?
I guess their producer's also pretty busy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It would've been a nice opportunity to get our song out there, but we don't really have a choice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm gonna have to politely turn down their offer...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Wait a second...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Shizuku and I could conceivably make it...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Unlike Haruka and Minori, we're credit-based, which means we don't always have to be at school.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But the four of us have always done everything together as MORE MORE JUMP! Would it be okay for us to go without them...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I mean, it's not like we have a rule saying that we have to do absolutely everything together...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I think all of us being present has made it easier to share responsibilities and move as a unit.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (At the same time, as we keep receiving offers, we won't be able to keep doing that...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If we want to be given more opportunities in the future, it might be best to have even just one of us appear...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Which means it'd be best to take advantage of the freedom allotted to us by the credit-based course.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I can't make this decision on my own. We need to discuss this as a group...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hi, Shizuku?
Sorry, I know it's late. Are you free to talk right now...?
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, you two!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about asking you to meet during lunch like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's fine... But you said there's something you wanted to talk about. Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, things are fine... But where do I begin?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Last night, while I was at home, I took another look at our schedule and made some adjustments. I've also already spoken to Shizuku about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Adjustments to our schedule?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We've had the fortune of receiving offers from various different people lately, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we only have a finite amount of time available to us, which means we're having to turn more and more down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I began wondering if there's a way for us to not have to do that as much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You've been doing all that for us, Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's nothing, really.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I had an idea and talked with Shizuku about it. Would you two mind taking a look at this...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our schedule...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...? Hang on...
There's stuff here for weekday afternoons now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's just you and Shizuku, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember how we're in the credit-based course? I was hoping we could take advantage of that and adjusted our schedule accordingly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right. This would definitely allow us to accept more offers...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do agree that we should accept whatever offers we can, even if all four of us can't be there...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, a lot of people out there want to see us together. As such, I'd like to be careful about which offers we do accept.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. This is just a preliminary idea. Just one solution for addressing how we may or may not accept more offers moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why I wanna hear what you think...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How do you feel about this, Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me...? Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I believe that we're gonna need to take on as many of these offers as we can if we're going to achieve our goal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I think Shizuku and I should take advantage of the freedom that the credit-based course affords us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right. I agree.
However...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't want to force you and Shizuku to carry a heavier burden than us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm not sure how I'd feel about you two working while we're at school...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I wouldn't worry about that.
After all, this is for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, being at school doesn't mean you have nothing to do, y'know...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's plenty you can do here, right? For example, coming up with ideas for our stream in between classes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If we go with this new scheduling scheme, we're gonna need you two to start handling more of those kinds of things. So, we'll be counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Y-Yeah! Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right, we should do what we can...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Again, we'll be counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I'll start putting together a new schedule with what we just discussed in mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Each day's gonna start to feel a lot busier as we take on all these new offers...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But let's do our best!
